newsitem.title: MEXICO: Veteran Mexico labor head in good condition - doctor.
newsitem.headline: Veteran Mexico labor head in good condition - doctor.

text.p: Hospitalized Mexican labor boss Fidel Velazquez, who turns 97 years old later this month, is in "good condition" and could go home on Sunday, his doctor said on Wednesday.
Velazquez is the powerful leader of the six-million-strong Mexican Workers Confederation (CTM), which has has swung unionized labor behind the government for more than half a century.
His doctor, Salomon Jasqui, told Reuters that Velazquez contracted the E coli bacteria after eating contaminated food at home.
"In English, it's commonly called Montezuma's revenge," Jasqui said.
After taking the commonly prescribed antibiotics for 10 days, Velazquez's condition failed to improve, so he was hospitalized and given a stronger antibiotic, Jasqui said.

Velazquez, a survivor of the Mexican Revolution and a reliable ally for a series of Mexican presidents, was hospitalized last month with an intestinal infection and last October with a lung infection.
